annotations.title: Find a stretch of a session

description: Find the stretch of a session's recording that stood out, wherever it began: the slowest kilometre of a run, the fastest 5 km, the 30 minutes of a ride with the lowest power, the 10 minutes with the highest heart rate. A window of a distance or a duration is slid across the whole recording sample by sample (not the watch's splits or laps), ranked by pace, speed, power, heart rate or cadence. Each stretch comes back with where it starts and ends (seconds and metres from the start), its pace, speed, average power, heart rate and cadence, and the climbing in it. Times include any stops inside the stretch.

athlete_id.description: May be omitted when you coach exactly one athlete.

count.description: How many stretches, none overlapping. Default 1, at most 10.

distance_m.description: Window by distance, e.g. 1000 for a kilometre. Give this or duration_sec.

duration_sec.description: Window by time, e.g. 1800 for 30 minutes.

metric.description: What to rank the stretches by. Default pace.

pick.description: Which end. slowest = lowest = the minimum; fastest = highest = the maximum. Default slowest.

workout_id.description: The session; its recording is found for you.

name: find_session_windows
